Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*

fun main() {
    try {
    val result = Xberg.ocrBackendSupportsLanguage("nonexistent-backend-xyz", "eng")
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
